title: Loading Dock
description: A dispatcher drags a shipment card onto a vehicle's column on the scheduling board to assign it. Assign a shipment to a vehicle and driver for a time slot, then confirm it shows up correctly.
successCondition: PUT /api/fleet/assignments/:shipmentId with a valid vehicleId, driverId, scheduledStart, and scheduledEnd returns 200, and the same assignment (matching vehicleId and driverId) appears in GET /api/fleet/assignments.
hints: GET /api/fleet/vehicles and GET /api/fleet/drivers list the valid ids to assign.
This endpoint requires a dispatcher or admin session — customer/driver tokens get 403.
